input.context: Selected rows from FRANCE1940's historical sources, values unchanged. Legal weekly-hours regime on each decree date and at the end of June 1940; armament share of national income on 1 January of each year it covers; SGF first-week hours surveys (all industries and metalworking) read at each survey week's midpoint, the 4th; Frankenstein's combat-aircraft production counts over calendar years 1936-1939 and January-June 1940; monthly combat-aircraft deliveries September 1939-May 1940; a definitional zero for production accumulated since 1 January 1936. No filling or interpolation.

indicator:legal_hours_cap_reading.how_to_measure: Legal weekly hours in force on the row's date, read from legal_hours_cap.

indicator:armaments_share_reading.how_to_measure: Armament share of national income in percent for the calendar year starting on the row's date, read from armaments_share.

indicator:industry_hours_survey.how_to_measure: SGF all-industry first-week survey in weekly hours, read from industry_hours.

indicator:metalworking_hours_survey.how_to_measure: SGF metalworking first-week survey in weekly hours, read from metalworking_hours.

indicator:cumulative_aircraft_origin.how_to_measure: Definitional zero of production accumulated since the study origin, read on 1 January 1936.

indicator:combat_aircraft_produced.how_to_measure: Combat aircraft produced over each recorded window: calendar years 1936-1939 and January-June 1940.

indicator:combat_aircraft_delivered.how_to_measure: Combat aircraft delivered in each recorded month, September 1939-May 1940.
